title: GCD / UMCP — Entering the Corpus: Ingress, Publication Architecture, and Guided Routes
source_native_claims: States the publication architecture of the corpus, assigns each major paper family one primary burden, publishes decision rules for route choice, and formalizes the casepack ladder that follows The First Pass.

The paper is companion rather than constitutional: it does not replace the Orientation Series, restate the full constitutional derivation, replace continuity or weld papers, or compete with closure papers on domain substance.
